steps.name: Before Hooks
Navigate to CAN Home Page
Open Mattamy Homes home page for CAN in STAGE
Verify home page loaded
Home page should finish loading
Home page title should include Mattamy Homes
Open Contact Us from the header
Click Contact Us
Open mobile navigation panel
Verify hero, title, URL country parameter, and country selector

CAN Contact page title should match
CAN Contact page URL should match
Contact page heading should be visible
Contact hero copy should be visible
Contact country selector heading should be visible
Contact area heading should be visible
Canada should be selected in the Contact country selector
